qualificationScope: read-only source integration review; no blocking finding in the reviewed contracts
reviewerRole: dev-portability implementation owner, reviewing UI/API/worker integration; not an independent reviewer of own provision/statusline implementation
method: Local read-only source inspection and source fingerprint comparison; no new tests executed in this review

checked.result: API selects machine telemetry or terminal resource samples without mixing, preserves the matching sample timestamp, and exposes resourcesStale; UI reads snapshot.resources and resourcesStale.
UI only interprets matchesPinned for profile-listed tools, maps ccswitch alias to cc-switch, and shows other tools as template-unspecified.
UI requires configured and resources before reporting resource display enabled.
Per-machine component key, unmount/auth abort epoch, and per-machine response serial prevent late data from repopulating another machine or regressing successful snapshot responses.
Worker adds schemaVersion and projects sessionSummary to terminalTelemetry with compatible numeric/null fields; API parses the fixed receipt tuple and strips unknown fields.
CAS machine/profile versions, node/address/user, canonical policy/profile/binding hashes and expiry are checked. Manifest byte SHA remains distinct from canonical public-profile SHA.

Node drops privilege through fixed runuser invocation; provision derives home from passwd, accepts no caller paths/commands/current selection, and preserves existing provider settings/active/default and Claude safety/hooks/unknown keys while replacing statusLine.

Root-installed module hashes bind provision/statusline/manifest; provision installs a byte-identical private user statusline and uses fixed version/URL/SHA downloads with bounded attempts and verified reuse.

Credentials use private stdin/vault/config only; public inventory projects metadata and credentialConfigured. Statusline reads native metadata only, no transcript body/network/model call, keeps missing quota unknown and labels CLI cost as estimate; no local five-hour fabricated balance or cumulative token claim.

existingLinuxEvidence.basis: Existing root-produced Linux validation receipt inspected; controller count also matches the five declared controller test cases. These Linux commands were not run by this reviewer.

notPerformedThisReview: Linux command execution or test rerun
production service operations or release deployment
notes: Qualification applies to the listed source contracts; operational deployment and live acceptance require their separate receipts.
Correct existing tools are reused; conflicting existing user-bin paths fail closed instead of overwriting user tools.
